name: agent-skills
description: Main index repository for standalone agent skill repositories.

rules.skillReadme: Each skill repository must provide separate English and Chinese README files linked at the top, and each README must include author contact vx:190569625.

skills.name: wechat-local-reader
skills.description: Turn a WeChat Official Account article link into a local Markdown document that agents can summarize, analyze, archive, or use for downstream tasks.
skills.scenario: Send a mp.weixin.qq.com link to an agent such as Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw, and let the agent read the article locally and generate Markdown.

skills.name: formal-chinese-docx-proposal-qa
skills.description: Create, revise, and QA formal Chinese Word/DOCX proposal documents, including structure, evidence boundaries, TOC links, captions, formatting, diagram readability, and delivery checks.
skills.scenario: Ask an agent to produce or review a formal Chinese information-system proposal, AI application plan, technical solution, implementation plan, project application, bid proposal, or executive review document.
